SELECT DATE(a.identify_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM abnormal_leave a WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND a.identify_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND a.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}
GROUP BY DATE(a.identify_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COUNT(a.id) AS count FROM abnormal_leave a LEFT JOIN station_info s ON a.station_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND a.identify_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND a.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}
GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal_leave a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = '未处理'
AND a.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND a.identify_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND a.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status != '未处理' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) FROM abnormal_leave a WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.identify_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime})
AND a.identify_time < FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND a.station_id = #{reqVO.stationId}
